description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod, which encapsulates a LeaveBalance object and an optional LeavePeriod object, providing getter and setter methods for each. It is part of the OrangeHRM leave management system, specifically within the LeaveRequest DTO namespace.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod
classes.description: A DTO class that holds a LeaveBalance object and an optional LeavePeriod object, representing the leave balance along with the associated leave period information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LeaveBalance and optional LeavePeriod members.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the LeavePeriod object, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLeavePeriod
methods.description: Sets the LeavePeriod object, or null.
